quality_gate: Full-correct cases must not regress; aggregate solved count must not decrease; provenance/conflicts/mandatory constraints retained; all failures and budget exhaustion counted.
cost_gate: Measured whole task E2E and live KV/actual token costs with identical Projected+APC control; no fixed10%/5% requirement or token-to-kernel conversion.
authorization: One bounded corrective revalidation under the active implement-and-fully-validate objective, after native CPU proof of the shared output-contract gap. Not a parameter search.
repair: Require both source-ordered DOCS slots, scope role instructions, constrain final answer syntax only. Fact values, input observations, verifier, scoring, budgets and runtime unchanged.
